headline: Deadlocked recounts the whole game and adds hundreds of small routines
summary: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 matched code changes from 4.13% to 4.03% after a wider inventory adds previously missing functions and code to the total. The report now has 3,165 of 18,085 functions finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. New batches and PAL-specific implementations land alongside the recount.
highlights: #17 extracts and rebuilds all 49 programs byte-identically on both discs, then recounts functions from the binaries.
#20 adds 463 small functions, #21 adds 425, #22 adds 68 and #23 adds 14.
#24 and #25 supply 32 PAL implementations for routines whose US C differs there.
Some older audit warnings reflect corrected function boundaries. The new catalogue checks the complete functions.
